title: Claimant Identity Verification — Appointments, Visits and Interpreter Service by Pathway
content:
Under Claimant Identity Verification, whether a claimant appears in person, books an appointment or may walk in depends on the proofing pathway of the case.

## Visit and booking terms

| Pathway | Claimant appears in person | Session booked as an appointment | Visit may be completed without an appointment (walk-in) | Scheduled session length (minutes) | Free interpreter on request |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | no | no | no | 0 (no scheduled session) | no |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | no | yes | no | 20 | yes |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | yes | yes | yes | 30 | yes |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | yes | no | yes | 15 | no |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | no | no | no | 0 (no scheduled session) | no |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | yes | yes | no | 45 | yes |

## Appointment limits

| Pathway | Earliest appointment: business days after the scheduling date | Reschedules allowed per case | Cancellation notice that avoids a missed appointment (hours before the appointment) | Missed appointments after which the case is failed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | 0 (no appointment) | 0 | 0 | 0 (no appointments on the pathway) |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | 1 | 2 | 24 | 2 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | 2 | 2 | 24 | 2 |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | 0 (no appointment) | 0 | 0 | 0 (no appointments on the pathway) |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | 0 (no appointment) | 0 | 0 | 0 (no appointments on the pathway) |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | 2 | 1 | 24 | 1 |

## What the figures mean for the claimant

A lead-time figure of 0 means the pathway has no appointment, and a missed-appointment limit of 0 means there are no appointments on the pathway; a session length of 0 means no session is scheduled. Business days for the lead time run Monday through Friday, excluding state holidays. The cancellation notice is counted in elapsed hours before the appointment.

The American Job Center pathway is both booked as an appointment and open to walk-in visits, so a claimant on that pathway may complete the visit either with a booked appointment or without one. The USPS retail office pathway is a walk-in visit with no appointment. On Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification a single missed appointment reaches the limit of 1, and the booking may be changed only once.

Interpreter service is free and is provided on request on the video, American Job Center and identity theft re-verification pathways; no free interpreter is provided on the online, USPS retail office or mail pathways.
